TESTIMONIALS
"Very well planned, best convention centre in Mangalore. So many halls of different capacities. It's a bouquet for all needs like conventions, weddings, parties of all sizes. The location is convenient and parking is plenty. The security assist are friendly and efficient. All the premises are well maintained.""
Rajesh Kamath
"Very good place to stay. Nice ambience, polite staff and management with tasty food in the heart of the city. Enjoyed our stay"
R Thippeswamy
"A really awesome place to stay in the city. It is very near to railway station and quite near to market. The rooms are comfortable and aura is calming. Breakfast buffet is good and sumptuous. There are various items on the menu and you will not be left wanting for more. Even dinner is good and food is very tasty. I had stayed there for more than 15 days, but never got bored with the food menu or taste. Staff is polite and really helpful. This is definitely going to be my go to place next time I am in town"
Vaibhav Srivastava
"Peaceful location and good business class hotel. Rooms are very clean and comfortable as per the covid protocol. Staffs are nice, polite and friendly. The food was main. Super good taste. The location was very peaceful and relaxing and good road view. Excellent professional staffs. Will come back again. All the best to The Ocean Pearl Inn Management"
Daniel Samuel
